hero.badge: A learning system, not a notebook
hero.text: Studytracker is a system that grows, reinforces and strengthens what you learn. Collect materials, turn them into questions and flashcards, defend what you know and see exactly where it still cracks.

butterfly.example: A butterfly is sitting on the flower.

run.example: I run in the park every morning.

loop.title: One loop. Three verbs.
loop.text: Notes alone fade. Studytracker keeps knowledge moving through a loop that grows it, reinforces it and makes it stronger every time you come back.

grow.text: Give everything you learn a place to live: an article, a lecture, a set of new words. Your knowledge base starts here.

reinforce.text: Turn it into questions and flashcards. Pulling an answer out of memory makes it stronger than reading it again.

strengthen.text: Defend what you know, get an honest score and see which topics crack. Then go back and grow exactly those.

loop.footer: Weak spots from Strengthen become the next things you Grow. The loop never stops, and neither does your progress.

how.title: From the first note to knowledge that holds
how.text: Five steps, one material. Click through them, the demos are live.

material.label: Add a material
material.title: Everything starts with a material
material.text: An article, a video, a practice task or a test. Give it a status and tags, then attach notes, questions and a dictionary to it.

questions.label: Create questions
questions.title: Turn it into questions
questions.text: Write questions in your own words or let AI draft them, and pick a difficulty. Three types cover most of what you need to check:

defend.label: Self defending
defend.title: Defend what you know
defend.text: Self defending is a quiz over a material's questions. They come in random order, and with every answer you say how sure you are. Try it:

score.label: Get a score
score.title: A score that is honest
score.text: Every answer gets 0 to 100. Open answers are checked by exact match first, then by fuzzy match, so a typo does not cost you; close answers in other words are checked by meaning. The attempt score is a weighted average where hard questions count three times.

statistics.label: Watch it grow
statistics.title: See what is getting stronger
statistics.text: Statistics follow you over time: score trend, study streak, accuracy by difficulty, how well your confidence matches reality and which tags are your weakest.

open.title: What light does chlorophyll absorb best?
open.note: Typed “red and blu light”? Fuzzy matching still counts it.

options.title: Which are products of photosynthesis?
options.note: One or more correct answers. Partial picks earn partial credit.

trueFalse.title: Plants release oxygen only at night.

feedback.rightUnsure: Right, but unsure. It will come back for another review.
feedback.rightSure: Confident and right. That is knowledge that holds.
feedback.wrongSure: Confident but wrong. Statistics flag this as overconfidence.
feedback.wrong: Not there yet. This question is now on your list to strengthen.

stats.calibration: How often you are right when you feel…

words.title: Words that stick.
words.text: Every material can have its own dictionary: words with translation, transcription, part of speech, examples and synonyms. Flashcards bring them back right before you would forget them.

lines: 📚 Knowledge is the only backpack that gets lighter the more you fill it.
🧠 Your brain called. It wants a snack: one small material, please.
🌱 Every expert was once a beginner who didn't quit after the first page.
☕ Coffee in one hand, curiosity in the other. Perfect setup.
🐢 Slow progress is still progress. Turtles finish races too.
🎯 Ten focused minutes beat an hour of “I'll start in a second”.
🔥 The best time to start was yesterday. The second best is right now.
🦉 Night owl or early bird, this page is open for both.
🧩 Today's confusion is tomorrow's “oh, that's easy”.
🚀 Small daily steps quietly turn into giant leaps.
🍕 Learning is like pizza: even a single slice counts.
🌧️ Bad day? Learn one tiny thing. It's a win nobody can take away.
💡 Questions are just answers that haven't been met yet.
🏋️ Memory is a muscle. Today is leg day for your neurons.
🎧 Put on a good playlist and pick one material. Future you says thanks.
🐝 Busy bees make honey; curious minds make knowledge.
📈 You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
🌍 Every word you learn is a new window to look out of.
🧘 Breathe in, open a material, breathe out. You've got this.
🕯️ A candle loses nothing by lighting another one. Neither does sharing what you learn.
🐣 Everything you love doing now, you once didn't know how to do.
🧭 Lost in a topic? That's just exploring with extra steps.
🎲 Spin the wheel of knowledge: today's prize is whatever you open next.
🌙 Tired? Even five minutes keeps the streak and the forgetting curve at bay.
✨ Mistakes are proof you're trying. Keep collecting them.
